page.overview:
Who is Akila?

Akila was more scholar than warrior, and at her mother's urging left Bana-Mighdall to be educated in Man's World and study engineering at Oxford University. She later traveled to Themyscira, where the Bana had relocated after the War of the Gods, and used her knowledge to resdesign the Shim'Tar armor with a mixture of advanced technology and magic. At Queen Hippolyta's request, she donned the new armor to aid Wonder Woman in defending Themyscira from Abu-Gita's invading ape forces.

During the Amazon Civil War, Akila discovered that the explosive devices used to attack sites in both Themyscira's capitol city and in Bana-Mighdall all originated from the same source. While explaining her discoveries to Artemis, both women were attacked by Amazon separatists. After being injured, she permanently relinquished the armor and title of Shim'Tar to Artemis, feeling that she was unworthy of the responsibility and Artemis was better suited to hold the title.
